round1: Chrissy ran away with Round 1 at 27 points, nailing Montreal, Ottawa, Colorado in 7 and San Jose in the right number of games. Stephanie brought up the rear with 9, and Marc, Chrissy and Derrick picked Ottawa in a series for roughly the sixth straight year, which is the one thing here they were all consistent at.
round2: Stephanie won the round with a modest 13 points as the only person to take Toronto over Ottawa, which is a low bar to clear. Marc picked Ottawa in this Round 2 series for the sixth year running and was wrong for the sixth time.
round3: Marc bagged 15 points as the only one to nail Detroit in seven games, jumping up to second. Chrissy and Stephanie both took Toronto, which lost, and spent the round proving that you can be loyal to a team without being right about it.
round4: Detroit beat Carolina in five, and Jaclyn and Derrick both picked the Hurricanes. For Jaclyn that means five straight years of being wrong about the Cup winner, and it isn't getting less funny. The other three took Detroit for 4 points each.
overall: Chrissy won back-to-back pools with 51 points, ahead of Marc (44) and Jaclyn (36), who spent the Final backing the wrong team yet again. Stephanie finished last at 29, her second time at the bottom. Marc has now picked the right Cup winner three years in a row, and Jaclyn has picked the wrong one five years in a row, which is a nice symmetry.
